exposure: concomitant anomalies (skeletal system, head and face, genital system)
cohort: The study included 49 cases of foetal thoracic hypoplasia.
finding: Most cases of foetal thoracic hypoplasia presented with additional anomalies (primarily skeletal and head-face), and approximately half of affected newborns died within the first 24 hours of life.
followup_time: up to the infantile period (first year of life)
